title: Non-blocking follow-ups from backend-trade-strategy-tagging-followups review (PR #252)
description: Non-blocking findings from the pr-reviewer pass on PR #252 (whitespace-normalization field_validator added to PositionIn.strategy), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's convention so they aren't lost once the PR merges.

checklist.step: `PositionIn._strip_and_normalize_entry_notes` and `PositionIn._strip_and_normalize_strategy` (backend/app/api/schemas.py) now have byte-for-byte identical bodies (strip; normalize a resulting empty string to None). Pydantic's `field_validator` decorator accepts multiple field names in one call (e.g. `@field_validator("entry_notes", "strategy")`), so these could be consolidated into a single validator function to avoid the duplication, rather than keeping two separately-named copies of the same four lines. Worth doing next time either validator needs to change, so the two don't silently drift apart. Non-blocking: no correctness impact today, purely a reuse/simplification cleanup.
